items.title: Leonard Bocage Interview, 1972-03-24
items.q: we had a contest Red Island against uh against John Kazmi I did against uh Kit Thomas

ctx.x: He's got a movie camera now. Yeah. So between the automobile and the movie, he never plays. Can you imagine? He makes movies of his own band and still playing. Yeah, that's a nice old fellow here, see.
Well, you see, Andrew took over the band after Kazmi died, you see, Kazmi used to lead that band, John. Yeah. Well, after John died, well, Andrew took the band over.
That's nuts. Did you ever play any advertisements on the trucks?
